sample.text: `_SKIP_DIR_NAMES` blanket-excluded any directory named exactly `lib`, `lib64`, `include`, `bin`, or `share` from analysis, regardless of location. These are common legitimate source directory names (Ruby gems keep all source in `lib/`, PlatformIO/Arduino firmware projects keep custom libraries in `lib/`, C/C++ projects keep headers in `include/`, Node packages ship CLI entrypoints in `bin/`), so real code was silently dropped from the analysis. The entries were also redundant: virtualenv directories are already fully pruned via the `venv`/`.venv`/`env`/`.env` entries, and `site-packages` remains excluded directly.

sample.text: fixed flaky `make e2e` / `test-environment` full-api-e2e: the suite reset shared org-core state (`POST /api/org/demo/reset`), so two concurrent runs (e.g. a local run plus parallel automation on the same Docker stack) wiped each other's project mid-flow, causing an intermittent `bootstrap-plan` 404 (`workspace null`). Root-caused via org-core diagnostics (a run's project was replaced by a later run's projects) and fixed by defaulting `E2E_RESET_STATE` to `false`: the Docker e2e is now append-only and concurrency-safe (all its assertions are existence/`>=` checks that tolerate accumulated state), so concurrent runs no longer clobber each other. Verified 0/6 workspace-404 failures (was ~3/5). The node-based `npm test` e2e was never affected — it uses isolated per-run temp state, which remains the clean-slate path;
